description: This file defines the RestExport class, a Drupal plugin for REST export display in Views, handling data responses for REST resources with configuration for content types, authentication, route collection, and response rendering.

classes.name: RestExport
classes.description: Drupal plugin class for REST export display, handling data responses, route collection, and rendering for RESTful resources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RestExport plugin with configuration, route provider, state, renderer, authentication, and format providers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the display, setting content type and mime type based on view request.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of display, which is 'data'.

methods.name: usesExposed
methods.description: Indicates that the display uses exposed filters.

methods.name: displaysExposed
methods.description: Indicates that the display does not display exposed filters.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the response mime type.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves the response mime type.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type for the response.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Gets the current content type.

methods.name: getAuthOptions
methods.description: Returns available authentication options.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines plugin options, including authentication and style settings.

methods.name: optionsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current options for display.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for configuration.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the options form.

methods.name: collectRoutes
methods.description: Collects and defines routes for the view display, including format and authentication requirements.

methods.name: overrideApplies
methods.description: Determines if the view overrides a given route based on path, method, and format.

methods.name: buildResponse
methods.description: Builds and returns a response object for the view, including cache and headers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the view and returns the rendered output.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the view output, handling live preview and cache metadata.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Returns the view render array for preview purposes.

methods.name: getFormatOptions
methods.description: Returns available serialization format options.
